name: headcountlabs-places
description: Find shops, restaurants, cafes, pharmacies, libraries and other places near a point in the 20 largest U.S. cities, with address, phone, website, weekly hours and open-now when hours are known. Filter by name, brand, category or open time, and count chain locations versus independents nearby. Data from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), Overture Maps, All the Places, Foursquare OS Places and city open data; each record names its sources. Read-only, no account or API key.
